WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages
), above_average AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ta.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
), scaled AS (
  SELECT telescref,
         avg_modindex,
         avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_overall,
         avg_modindex / AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS ratio
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT telescref, avg_modindex, above_overall, ratio
FROM scaled
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with no non-NULL modulation_index values are excluded because they have no per-telescope average; AVG ignores NULL values.
